title: Intrinsic PAPR: Tackling Misattribution in 3D Intrinsic Decomposition via Proximity Attention Point Rendering
abstract: arXiv:2407.00500v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent point-based intrinsic decomposition and inverse rendering methods have advanced the modelling of the shading and albedo of 3D scenes. However, we identify a fundamental limitation: these methods suffer from a misattribution issue, where individual primitives learn incorrect appearance features despite producing correct aggregated renderings. We show that the root cause lies in volume rendering, which aggregates translucent primitives along each ray and only supervises the final colour, preventing direct supervision of individual primitive features. To address this, we propose Intrinsic PAPR, a robust intrinsic decomposition framework which leverages Proximity Attention Point Rendering (PAPR) to enable direct per-point supervision. translated_title: 内在PAPR：通过邻近注意力点渲染解决三维内在分解中的归属错误问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2407.00500v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：最近基于点的内在分解和逆渲染方法在三维场景的着色和反照率建模方面取得了进展。然而，我们识别出一个根本性限制：这些方法存在归属错误问题，即单个图元学习到不正确的外观特征，尽管生成了正确的聚合渲染结果。我们证明其根源在于体积渲染，它沿每条射线聚合半透明图元，仅监督最终颜色，从而无法直接监督单个图元特征。为解决此问题，我们提出内在PAPR，一个稳健的内在分解框架，利用邻近注意力点渲染（PAPR）实现直接逐点监督。与体积渲染方法不同，PAPR消除了半透明图元，直接在射线-表面交点处预测外观，从而实现对每个图元特征的准确监督。
tldr: 本文提出内在PAPR框架，通过邻近注意力点渲染替代体积渲染，实现逐点直接监督，从而解决三维内在分解中的特征归属错误问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Intrinsic PAPR, a framework that replaces volume rendering with proximity attention point rendering to enable direct per-point supervision, addressing the misattribution issue in 3D intrinsic decomposition.
